# TASK-071 — specification

## Scope

Feature flags: every optional feature can be switched on or off by a workspace Owner/Admin in Settings → Administration. The API refuses a disabled feature's routes (403 `feature-disabled`), `queueAiJob` refuses AI and Claude Agent runs from any route, the worker fails queued jobs of a disabled feature, sign-in options hide Google/SSO, and the web client hides views, actions and tour steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Feature flags: a workspace Owner/Admin can switch every optional feature on or off from Administration.
- [x] The server enforces the switch (routes, AI queueing, worker, sign-in options); the client hides the matching views, actions and tour steps.
